Sofia Li: Nightly scans failed on canary. SAST reported high in auth/token_parser.go and DAST couldn't download test-fixtures due to KMS decrypt=403. CI artifacts blocked. @Noah can you grab logs?
Noah Grant: Paste from artifacts: ```rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = Request had insufficient permissions for resource projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/ci/cryptoKeys/fixtures-decrypt, principal=ci-runner@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com```
security-bot: nightly-scan 4315001234: status=FAIL, sast=1 high, dast=1 medium, infra=KMS_DECRYPT_403
Sofia Li: Could be an IAM rollout earlier today. infra-ci, any policy syncs?
infra-ci: automated-sync 4314990000: applied iam-policy bundle for project:redwood-prod; change id CH-2410. No intentional removal noted but bundle generation changed key bindings template.
Noah Grant: I'll run auditlog slice: `gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.methodName="SetIamPolicy" AND resource.type="cloudkms_key_ring"' --limit 25 --project=redwood-prod` and report.
Rakesh K.: SAST finding is valid: token_parser.go lacks strict length checks on input token header. I'll pick it up and open PR. Don't suppress.
Sofia Li: Ops proposal to unblock: grant ci-runner key-decrypter with a conditional TTL 3h. Ops, prepare the command and hold until audit evidence attached.
ops-oncall: dry-run command ready: `gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding fixtures-decrypt --keyring=ci --location=global --member='serviceAccount:ci-runner@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com' --role='roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter' --condition="expression=request.time < timestamp('2026-04-05T04:00:00Z'),title=temp_unblock" --project=redwood-prod` Waiting for go-ahead.
Noah Grant: auditlog shows SetIamPolicy by infra-automation at 2026-04-05T00:30Z that replaced key bindings; previous binding for ci-runner missing after change. Logged evidence to CH-2410 and pinged infra-team.
Sofia Li: ok ops, apply after attaching CH-2410 link in the change. Rakesh, can you estimate PR ETA?
Rakesh K.: PR will be up in ~2h with tests. I'll also add a SAST evaluator rule to flag missing length checks in token parsing.
security-bot: re-run queued after ops change. (run 4315001240)
ops-oncall: applied conditional binding and annotated CH-2410. Re-run started.
security-bot: re-run 4315001240: result=PASS, sast=PASS (after backport), dast=PASS, infra=OK
Sofia Li: Good. Follow-ups: infra to fix policy generator template to preserve key-level bindings; add nightly preflight `gcloud kms keys test-iam-permissions` for important keys; document conditional binding procedure in runbook. I'll open an incident stub for postmortem.
Noah Grant: Incident stub INC-2026-04-05-kms-rbac created and assigned to Sofia.
Sofia Li: thanks team, closing once infra confirms template fix.
